title: Add a --upper flag to a CLI
prompt: cli.ts prints a greeting for the name given as the first argument. Add a `--upper` flag that prints the greeting in upper case. Keep the default output.
check: [ "$(bun cli.ts Ada)" = "Hello, Ada!" ] && [ "$(bun cli.ts Ada --upper)" = "HELLO, ADA!" ] && [ "$(bun cli.ts --upper Ada)" = "HELLO, ADA!" ]
